reason: Stream X (PLAN §9): a 200,000-token working-context ceiling for large windows. resolve_context_limits sizes the working context from min(input_capacity, ceil(200,000/0.75)): target <= 200K, compacted target, compactor segment budgets and summary allowance, the in-turn clearing watermark and checkpoint receipts scale from that working input; hard capacity checks keep the real window. A configured options.context_window above the ceiling opts into a larger working context. Core reports binding_limit 'ceiling' plus window_limit; the Working context label and the provider dialog's Context window help text say so (copy only). Every consumer reads the shared limits: _model_context, _estimate_limits/_with_tool_history clearing, mid-turn compaction headroom, context status/meter, runtime-switch preflight, missions (orchestration target), precompaction (Stream P, merged as #619, reads target_input_tokens). Python: test_context.py (ceiling/opt-in/routes/compactor plan units), test_in_turn_context_pruning.py (clearing at the ceiling vs opt-in on a 1M catalog window), test_chat_context_assembly.py (context status), test_chat_api.py (API payloads), and the files that consume limits: test_midturn_compaction.py, test_model_output_budget.py, test_tool_history_memory.py, test_history_content_fidelity.py, test_chat_reference_material.py, test_conversation_search.py, test_turn_preflight_latency.py, test_orchestration.py, test_precompaction.py. Frontend: WorkingContextPanel label cases, client mapping, SettingsPage help text, App journeys. Playwright: area:working-context, a new area:provider-options (the provider dialog's Context window help, desktop/mobile Chromium/mobile WebKit) and entry:assistant on the three engines (SessionsPage renders the panel).
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. SettingsPage.tsx otherwise falls to the whole-file desktop-interface/mobile-layout fallback areas; only its Context window help copy changed, so the new focused provider-options area (added without a rule, selected explicitly) covers it. tests/v3/test_chat.py and tests/v3/test_api.py are large; their large-window and runtime-switch tests were run locally by -k (8 passed) and are not selected. Real-Core evidence (OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, 1M routes: target 200,000 and binding 'ceiling'; 500K configured opt-in; 16K configured; runtime-switch preflight target 200,000; label at a LAN origin on the production bundle) is in the PR body. Native/Tauri unaffected.
